company.shortDescription: Tapi is a fintech company that provides e-wallet solutions and merchant services for both online and in-store transactions.
company.description: Tapi is a fintech company that provides e-wallet solutions and merchant services for both online and in-store transactions. It offers a comprehensive range of financial technology services designed to facilitate seamless transactions and enhance financial management. Their payment solutions include digital payment processing for businesses, allowing integration with various payment methods. They also provide e-wallet services, enabling consumers to manage their transactions easily through mobile wallets that feature balance management and transaction history. For merchants, Tapi offers tools to accept payments both online and in-store, along with analytics and reporting features to track sales effectively. Additionally, they facilitate cross-border transactions, providing services for international payments and currency exchange. To ensure security, Tapi implements fraud prevention tools and robust measures for data protection
